posture: 164 roles · 42 strong-act · 3 day-rate/interim briefs still live — afternoon refresh, every carried-forward item re-opened in Chrome; 147 of 149 morning items re-confirmed live, 2 dropped, 17 new roles added
summary: Afternoon refresh is Chrome-verified end to end: all 149 morning items were re-opened at their own deep links and 147 still resolve to live postings. Two were dropped as no longer advertised — the Peoplebank internal audit senior manager contract, which was this morning's top pick, and Commonwealth Superannuation Corporation's Senior Manager, Data Governance; if you were going to call Peoplebank about the audit brief, that window has closed, which is the day's lesson about recruiter-held contract work. Seventeen new roles came through since 04:30, led by a Kennards Self Storage CFO seat posted this morning and two Sydney Metro senior-manager assignments in data governance and technology assurance; Quantium now has four executive-manager roles running at once. Browser-verified this run: the Seek query battery including Board Appointments and non-executive director searches, I Work for NSW keyword searches, EthicalJobs board listings, Board Direction, and the Bluefin, Kaizen, Robert Half, Sharp & Carter and Morgan McKinley live-roles pages. AICD Directorship Opportunities remains member-gated with no public teasers on its landing page, so it is worth a manual look if you hold a subscription. Coverage is still a sample rather than the whole market, so a manual sweep of your priority recruiters remains worthwhile.
